plan_review.notes: Changed host from live-capture visual-review-agent to a supplied-screenshot sibling runner; batch records individual provider failures instead of aborting.

independent_grade.notes: The diff cleanly adds an advisory equipment art-direction review runner, a small reusable normalization/discovery library, targeted tests for prompt construction, response validation, unsupported-claim rejection, summary aggregation, and capture discovery, plus appropriate handoff/review-ledger artifacts. The implementation is scoped to agent review tooling and keeps the live visual-review gate separate. Coverage is good for the pure validation logic, though provider retry behavior is only covered structurally rather than with an injected provider test. No blocker-severity correctness, policy, or maintainability issues were found.
